summary.text: Alan Gordon is the Republican nominee. He is not a lawyer; he holds a self-designed bachelor's degree and an LL.B. from the University of Buckingham in England, and co-leads The Healing Church, which uses cannabis in religious services. He ran for attorney general in 2018 as the Compassion Party nominee. His platform centers on constitutional rights, public corruption and applying one standard of justice to all; he describes himself as a longtime cannabis activist.

paragraphs.text: Self-designed Bachelor of Arts from Penn State (1992) focused on cannabis-reform law and policy; honors LL.B. from the University of Buckingham, England (2012), per his campaign site.
Provides private ecclesiastical legal guidance to several Christian church organizations, according to his campaign biography.
Compassion Party nominee for Attorney General in 2018.
